Name: Morris to Morissa - Female Morris Gender Swap Portraits and Sprites
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
Morris to Morissa fully replaces Morris with a female version named Morissa. Same corporate menace. Just way hotter.

✨ Now with more compatibility! ✨

[b]What does this mod do?:[/b]
Replaces Morris's name, pronouns, portraits, sprites, and the Joja Form signature, too! 
This mod does not add any new content such as events or dialogue. It only patches art work and existing compatible content for Morris.

[b]Config:[/b] 
Portrait and sprite glasses can be toggled through config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu.

[b]Compatibility: [/b]
✔️ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
✔️ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]
✔️ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]
✔️ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12667]Morris Redeemed[/url]
✔️ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]Joja Clerks[/url]
✔️ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC Map Locations[/url]
✔️ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47483]Joja Worship Center[/url]
✔️ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] (just disable Morris in that mod’s config)
✔️ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] (just keep vanilla Morris in that mod's config)

[b]Warning/Not Supported:[/b]
⚠️ Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion, and other dialogue expansion packs: 
Some added dialogue may still call her Morris or use he/him pronouns.
❌ Marry Morris, Across the Aisle, A Little More Cutscenes, and other Morris portrait, dialogue, or cutscene expansions:
These mods may cause mismatched artwork, incorrect pronouns, missing sprites, or Morris to reappear. Compatibility may be added later.
